title: The ind-etale lift along a closed subscheme
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $\overline C$ an ind-etale $A/I$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], regarded as an $A$-algebra through $A\to A/I$. Let $\mathcal N_A(\overline C)$ have objects factorizations $A\to B\xrightarrow{q}\overline C$, with $B/A$ etale of finite presentation, and morphisms $(B,q)\to(B',q')$ the $A$-algebra maps $f:B\to B'$ satisfying $q'\circ f=q$; identities and composition are those of algebra maps. Here etale means that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and finite presentation is as in [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra].

For size, use the small presentation model with $B=A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$, $n,m\geq0$, finite lists of polynomials over $A$, the etale condition, and all $A$-algebra maps $q:B\to\overline C$; retain all compatible algebra maps as morphisms, regardless of the presentations. Define the diagram by $(B,q)\mapsto B$ and $f\mapsto f$. Define the $A$-algebra
$$H_A(\overline C)=\varinjlim_{\mathcal N_A(\overline C)} B$$
as the chosen colimit in the category of commutative $A$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], whose existence is supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-commutative-algebras-colimits-exist]. Write $\iota_{(B,q)}:B\to H_A(\overline C)$ for its structure maps. Retain the map $\epsilon_{\overline C}:H_A(\overline C)\to\overline C$ induced by the cocone $q$, characterized by $\epsilon_{\overline C}\circ\iota_{(B,q)}=q$.

For another ind-etale $A/I$-algebra $\overline C'$ and an $A/I$-algebra map $\phi:\overline C\to\overline C'$, postcomposition defines $\mathcal N_A(\phi):(B,q)\mapsto(B,\phi\circ q)$ and $f\mapsto f$. Define $H_A(\phi):H_A(\overline C)\to H_A(\overline C')$ as the map induced by the cocone with component $\iota_{(B,\phi\circ q)}$, so that
$$H_A(\phi)\circ\iota_{(B,q)}=\iota_{(B,\phi\circ q)}.$$
